Corrigendum for Appointment of one Security Guard on daily wages on
current D.C. rate of Chandigarh against vacant post of Security Guard
Please note the below amended information:
1. The Place, date and time of interview will be informed to the eligible candidates
after screening the application.
2. Interview will be held of those candidates who will submit properly completed
application forms in response to the aforementioned advertisement notice.
Applicants may apply either through Email: Pucc.nsw@gmail.com / by Post
office / by hand in the office Pucc, Nihal Singh Wala on or before 04/11/2026
(5.00 PM).
No application will be entertained after 04/11/2026 (5.00 PM).
The other eligibility criteria and terms & conditions remain unchanged
(please refer to earlier notification/advertisement: Ref. No.96/D/PUCCNSW, dated:
22/10/2026)
Principal
